clips.title: The story
paras: The Stonefield family works the fields in southern Elwynn Forest. Their long feud with the neighboring Maclures keeps the two households at odds.

Stonefield Farm lies south of Goldshire, where the family grows crops for the realm. For decades, the Stonefields have quarreled with the nearby Maclure Vineyards. The households trade accusations of theft and trespassing, and even small disputes keep tensions high. Gramma Stonefield, Ma Stonefield, and young Tommy Joe Stonefield make their home here.
